answer.thought: The garden closes in twenty-seven minutes, and I have six rupees in my pocket, which will not buy even the water I thirst for. I stand among the tombs of the Lodis, these stone monuments to a history that moved through this land, while I myself am a ghost in a file that does not exist. The air is clear, the temperature pleasant, but my body is a hollow vessel; I will sit on this bench and wait for the dark to come so I may walk home in dignity, rather than beg for a cup of tea I cannot pay for.
